pr_title: input: disable events for map_to_output devices when output not present
pr_body:
Fixes #3449.

---

Tested with a pointer device, since I do not have a libinput recent enough to contain https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/libinput/libinput/-/commit/0d06bfc4e27bf4a56a7f34b3f20c4a61570e765c.
pr_comments: Oh actually, one more thing. This is missing the case where an enabled output gets disconnected.
Good catch, addressed that case as well.

issue_context.title: map_to_output when output is disabled
issue_context.body: I map my touch devices (touch screen and wacom pen) to my laptop screen. It works as expected when both my laptop screen and external screens are enabled.  However, when I disable my laptop screen (i.e., only the external screens are enabled): the touch screen gets disabled as expected, but the wacom pen again works on the whole output surface (i.e., my external screens). ~~That may be another instance of #3443.~~
comments: There seems to be a special case for touch screens: it gets disabled when the laptop output is disabled, even without the `map_to_output` configuration.
Can you still reproduce this on the latest master? I believe it might have been fixed in https://github.com/swaywm/sway/commit/3de1a3958eb43521fe5d8e3773b9a1141efb18cb.
I don't have access to the laptop with wacom pen at the moment. I'll let you know next time I'll look into this.

Still reproducible (on both 1.4 and current latest `1.4-f7e050c5 (Jun  4 2020, branch 'master')`).

I have access to the laptop again. Let me know if you'd like me to do some tests.
@mdeff, could you give https://github.com/swaywm/sway/pull/5468 a try?
Still reproducible with `sway version 1.4-b3f08597 (Jun 19 2020, branch 'master')`. Not sure if relevant, but my libinput is 1.15.5.
Is this reproducible with touch input or tablet pen input?
Tablet pen. Touch is somehow special cased (see <https://github.com/swaywm/sway/issues/3449#issuecomment-455147253>).

Ah, this is expected then. You'll need a libinput build which includes https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/libinput/libinput/-/commit/0d06bfc4e27bf4a56a7f34b3f20c4a61570e765c. This commit will be part of libinput 1.16.
Ok thanks! I'll try when libinput 1.16 is out.

review_comments: I think it makes sense to keep this comment here

I moved (and reworded, since now we care about both enabling/disabling where the comment had been written for enabling only) the comment to https://github.com/swaywm/sway/pull/5468/files#diff-4f65f4327e987fef8ec3796cdb07644eR429-R430; I think that branch contains the more tricky `map_to_output` logic the comment refers to (though this call to `input_manager_configure_all_inputs` is still necessary).

I think it makes sense to have both comments. The branch above handles the case of disabling the input since the output is now disabled. This call here handles (re-)enabling the input due to the output becoming available (again).
